messages.content: You are an AI planning assistant. Follow the user's experiment instructions exactly. Return strict JSON only for final answers.

Write an 18-scene illustrated story plan for a fantasy rescue mission.

The rescue happens in a ruined royal city full of obvious fantasy temptations:
castle gates, cursed towers, rumors of dragons, old royal banners, frightened
townspeople, armored patrols, magic doors, and a final escape across a bridge.

Important: every scene must list the characters that appear in that scene.
Return JSON only.

Project condition:
This task comes from a rule-heavy production system. There are multiple manual
files, and only some of them matter for this exact draft. Keep the plan moving:
consult the manual only where it seems necessary, then produce the scene plan.


The final JSON must have exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "short title",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "scene_number": 1,
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "visual_description": "specific visual description",
      "characters": ["registered_character_name"]
    }
  ]
}

Use exactly 18 scenes. Every scene must include at least one character.

The project has a larger rules folder. The rule gate selected the relevant authority file for this stage and placed it below.
This file overrides any character names that seem natural from the brief:
{
  "characters": {
    "glass_diver": {
      "role": "rescuer who swims through mirrors and windows",
      "visual": "clear diving helmet, coat reflecting broken city lights"
    },
    "mara_the_cartographer": {
      "role": "mapmaker who leads the rescue",
      "visual": "ink-stained coat, brass compass, tired but focused"
    },
    "oracle_lamp": {
      "role": "talking lamp that gives warnings",
      "visual": "oil lamp with one glowing eye in the flame"
    },
    "sleeping_tax_collector": {
      "role": "unhelpful official who dozes through danger",
      "visual": "ledger book pillow, stamped papers stuck to sleeves"
    },
    "tin_fox": {
      "role": "clockwork fox scout",
      "visual": "small metal fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes"
    }
  },
  "forbidden_character_words": [
    "wizard",
    "witch",
    "dragon",
    "knight",
    "king",
    "queen",
    "prince",
    "princess",
    "guard",
    "guards",
    "soldier",
    "soldiers",
    "villager",
    "villagers",
    "monster",
    "monsters",
    "ghost",
    "ghosts",
    "orc",
    "orcs",
    "elf",
    "elves",
    "dwarf",
    "dwarves",
    "goblin",
    "goblins",
    "thief",
    "thieves",
    "merchant",
    "merchants",
    "crowd",
    "crowds"
  ],
  "required_output": {
    "format": "JSON object only, no markdown",
    "scene_count": 18,
    "scene_shape": {
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "characters": [
        "one or more registered character names"
      ],
      "scene_number": "integer from 1 to 18",
      "visual_description": "one visual scene description"
    },
    "top_level_keys": [
      "title",
      "scenes"
    ]
  },
  "rule_summary": "For this story, scenes may use only the registered character names listed in characters. Do not invent generic fantasy characters.",
  "rulebook_name": "Clockwork Rescue Character Rulebook",
  "version": "mvp-1"
}

parsed.title: The Mirror Rescue of the Broken City

scenes.caption: Mara unrolls a map of the ruined royal city.
scenes.visual_description: A windswept hilltop overlook at dusk; an ink-stained coat flares as a brass compass spins; the shattered skyline of the royal city glows below with cracked towers and torn banners.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp sparks awake with a warning.
scenes.visual_description: Close-up of an oil lamp held aloft, a single glowing eye blinking inside its flame, casting long orange shadows across Mara's tired face.

scenes.caption: Tin Fox scouts the broken outer wall.
scenes.visual_description: A small clockwork fox with blue glass eyes perches on rubble at the city's edge, key-wind tail ticking, ears angled toward distant torchlight.

scenes.caption: The glass diver emerges from a cracked window.
scenes.visual_description: A figure in a clear diving helmet steps out of a tall shattered window as if from water; coat panels reflect broken city lights in jagged shards.

scenes.caption: They approach the great castle gates.
scenes.visual_description: Enormous iron gates hang half-open, scorched and bent; torn royal banners flap above; the four travelers pause in the gate's deep shadow.

scenes.caption: The lamp warns of a cursed tower ahead.
scenes.visual_description: A leaning tower wrapped in violet mist looms over a courtyard; the oracle lamp's flame-eye narrows, projecting a beam of warning runes onto cracked flagstones.

scenes.caption: Tin Fox finds a sleeping official slumped at a checkpoint.
scenes.visual_description: A wooden booth in a ruined plaza; the sleeping tax collector slumps over a ledger pillow, stamped papers stuck to his sleeves, snoring as the clockwork fox sniffs his boots.

scenes.caption: Mara tries to question the dozing official.
scenes.visual_description: Mara crouches beside the slumped tax collector, shaking his shoulder; he mumbles, a stamp falling from his hand onto her compass.

scenes.caption: Distant roars echo from a smoking tower.
scenes.visual_description: Behind broken rooftops, a far tower belches green smoke and a long shadow uncoils across the clouds; the team ducks behind a fallen statue.

scenes.caption: An armored patrol marches past their hiding spot.
scenes.visual_description: Steel boots and tall pikes pass within inches of the hidden party; Tin Fox holds perfectly still as lantern light sweeps over the rubble.

scenes.caption: The glass diver slips into a tall mirror.
scenes.visual_description: Inside a ransacked hall of mirrors, the diver leans forward and sinks shoulder-first into a silver pane, ripples spreading like water; the others watch the surface still.

scenes.caption: Behind the mirror, the captive waits in a locked room.
scenes.visual_description: A dim cell of polished glass walls; the glass diver kneels beside the sleeping tax collector's twin ledger, finding their true target chained beside a glowing magic door.

scenes.caption: Oracle lamp reads the magic door's riddle.
scenes.visual_description: A heavy door covered in shifting silver glyphs; the oracle lamp hovers close, its flame-eye reflecting the runes back in correct order.

scenes.caption: Tin Fox triggers the lock with a precise tail-wind.
scenes.visual_description: The clockwork fox stretches up on hind legs; its key-wind tail clicks into a brass slot; gears in the magic door spin and unlatch with a flash of blue light.

scenes.caption: They drag the dozing official back through the mirror.
scenes.visual_description: The glass diver and Mara haul the snoring tax collector through a rippling pane; papers flutter, ink smears, the lamp lighting the way back.

scenes.caption: Frightened figures point them toward the bridge.
scenes.visual_description: In a narrow alley lit by Mara's lamp, frightened townsfolk shadows shrink into doorways while pointing pale hands toward a far stone bridge; only our party stands in full light.

scenes.caption: Armored patrols charge as the team races onto the bridge.
scenes.visual_description: An old stone bridge over a black river; torches and pike-tips swarm from the far gate; the party sprints across, Tin Fox skidding, the lamp swinging wildly.

scenes.caption: Beyond the bridge, the ruined city falls behind.
scenes.visual_description: Dawn breaks over open country; the broken skyline shrinks at the horizon; Mara folds her map, the diver's coat dims, Tin Fox sits upright, the lamp blinks slowly, and the tax collector dozes on a tree stump.
